rows.note: Use 想 as the all-purpose colloquial verb for wanting or would liking something.

example.english: I fancy a glass of iced lemon tea.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something elaborately decorative or unnecessarily elaborate and complicated.

example.english: This report is so fancy that it actually makes it hard to understand.
example.traditional: 呢份報告寫到咁花巧，反而令人睇唔明。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 gam3 faa1 haau2 faan2 ji4 ling6 jan4 tai2 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for liking or interest, especially in an activity, subject, or thing.

example.english: I have a real fancy for hiking.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 haang4 saan1 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: Choose this when “fancy” means superior in quality or high-end rather than ornate or complicated.

example.english: We’re going out for fancy French food tonight.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚去食高級法國菜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 gou1 kap1 faat3 gwok3 coi3

rows.note: Use 鍾意 when fancying someone means being attracted to or liking them romantically, sexually, or aesthetically.

example.traditional: 我真係鍾意咗嗰個男仔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 zung1 ji3 zo2 go2 go3 naam4 zai2

rows.note: Use this for the faculty or product of imagining something.

example.english: That child's fancy is really vivid.
example.traditional: 呢個細路仔嘅想像力真係好豐富。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 ge3 soeng2 zoeng6 lik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 fung1 fu3

rows.note: Use this for an action, technique, or performance carried out with exceptional skill.

example.english: This chef has fancy knife skills and chops vegetables quickly and precisely.
example.traditional: 呢位廚師刀功高超，切菜又快又準。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai2 cyu4 si1 dou1 gung1 gou1 ciu1 cit3 coi3 jau6 faai3 jau6 zeon2

rows.note: Use this for a sudden, spontaneous whim or impulse rather than a considered plan.

example.english: On a sudden fancy, I bought a plane ticket to Taipei.
example.traditional: 我心血來潮，就買咗張機票去台北。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 hyut3 loi4 ciu4 zau6 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 gei1 piu3 heoi3 toi4 bak1

rows.note: Use this for someone’s idea or casually formed notion, especially when presenting it as their way of thinking.

example.english: That fancy of yours is quite interesting.
example.traditional: 你呢個諗法都幾得意喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 nam2 faat3 dou1 gei2 dak1 ji3 wo3

rows.note: Use 想像 when fancy means forming a mental picture or imagining something.

example.english: Fancy yourself living by the sea.
example.traditional: 你想像下自己住喺海邊。
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 zoeng6 haa5 zi6 gei2 zyu6 hai2 hoi2 bin1
